<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    散点图模板
    用途: 相关性分析、数据分布展示
    适用场景: 价格vs销量、投入vs产出、身高vs体重
    支持: 2个系列，每系列多个数据点
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 数据点阴影 -->
        <filter id="scatterShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
        
        <!-- 系列1渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="dotGrad1" cx="30%" cy="30%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </radialGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列2渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="dotGrad2" cx="30%" cy="30%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>广告投入与销售额关系分析</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年各区域数据 · 样本量 N=24</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(950, 70)">
        <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="url(#dotGrad1)"/>
        <text x="28" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>线上渠道</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <circle cx="130" cy="10" r="8" fill="url(#dotGrad2)"/>
        <text x="148" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>线下渠道</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- 网格线 -->
        <!-- 水平网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1100" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="470" x2="1100" y2="470" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="380" x2="1100" y2="380" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="290" x2="1100" y2="290" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="200" x2="1100" y2="200" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- 垂直网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="160" x2="300" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="460" y1="160" x2="460" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="620" y1="160" x2="620" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="780" y1="160" x2="780" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="940" y1="160" x2="940" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1100" y1="160" x2="1100" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- Y轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="125" y="565" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>0</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>200</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="385" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>400</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>600</tspan></text>
        <text x="125" y="205" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="end"><tspan>800</tspan></text>
        
        <!-- Y轴标题 -->
        <text x="45" y="360" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 45, 360)">
            <tspan>销售额（万元）</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="140" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>0</tspan></text>
        <text x="300" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>20</tspan></text>
        <text x="460" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>40</tspan></text>
        <text x="620" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>60</tspan></text>
        <text x="780" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>80</tspan></text>
        <text x="940" y="590" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>100</tspan></text>
        
        <!-- X轴标题 -->
        <text x="620" y="625" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#5D6D7E" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>广告投入（万元）</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 坐标轴 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="160" x2="140" y2="560" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1100" y2="560" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 
        数据点计算：
        X: 140 + (value/100) * 960
        Y: 560 - (value/800) * 400
        -->
        
        <!-- 趋势线（线上渠道） -->
        <line x1="180" y1="505" x2="1020" y2="215" stroke="#2196F3" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,4" opacity="0.5"/>
        
        <!-- 趋势线（线下渠道） -->
        <line x1="220" y1="515" x2="900" y2="295" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,4" opacity="0.5"/>
        
        <!-- 系列1: 线上渠道数据点（蓝色） -->
        <circle cx="220" cy="470" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="300" cy="425" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="340" cy="445" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="420" cy="380" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="350" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="540" cy="320" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="620" cy="310" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="700" cy="270" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="780" cy="250" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="860" cy="230" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="940" cy="210" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="1000" cy="195" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad1)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 系列2: 线下渠道数据点（绿色） -->
        <circle cx="260" cy="490" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="320" cy="460" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="460" cy="400" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="540" cy="380" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="600" cy="365" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="680" cy="340" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="740" cy="325" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="820" cy="305" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="880" cy="290" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="920" cy="280" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
        <circle cx="980" cy="265" r="10" fill="url(#dotGrad2)" filter="url(#scatterShadow)"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 统计信息卡片 -->
    <g id="statsPanel" transform="translate(1120, 160)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="200" rx="8" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1"/>
        
        <text x="70" y="30" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>统计摘要</tspan>

        </text>
        <text x="25" y="95" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="12" fill="#7F8C8D">
            <tspan>R² = 0.94</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="25" y="112" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="12" fill="#7F8C8D">

        <text x="40" y="145" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="13" fill="#5D6D7E">

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- Slide 02: Employment Status Overview -->
    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="topBarGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0076A8"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>

    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Gradient top bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="url(#topBarGrad)"/>

    <text x="60" y="50" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        <tspan>84% of Developers Are Working, but Full-Time Employment Dips in the U.S.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Takeaway box -->
    <rect x="60" y="75" width="1160" height="40" rx="4" fill="#005587"/>
    <text x="80" y="102" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF">
        <tspan>U.S. full-time employment dropped 4.2pp year-over-year (69% → 64.8%), signaling a shift toward contractors</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Left column: Global Employment -->
    <text x="60" y="150" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>Global Employment Status</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Global bar chart -->
    <g transform="translate(60, 170)">
        <!-- Full-time: 69% -->
        <text x="0" y="20" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>Full-time</tspan></text>
        <rect x="120" y="5" width="690" height="24" rx="4" fill="#005587"/>
        <text x="820" y="22" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>69%</tspan></text>

        <!-- Freelance: 16.4% -->
        <text x="0" y="60" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>Freelance</tspan></text>
        <rect x="120" y="45" width="164" height="24" rx="4" fill="#0076A8"/>
        <text x="294" y="62" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>16.4%</tspan></text>

        <!-- Student: 13.2% -->
        <text x="0" y="100" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>Student</tspan></text>
        <rect x="120" y="85" width="132" height="24" rx="4" fill="#D04A02"/>
        <text x="262" y="102" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>13.2%</tspan></text>
    </g>

    <!-- Right column: U.S. Comparison -->
    <text x="700" y="150" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#005587">
        <tspan>U.S. Full-Time Trend</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- U.S. comparison visual -->
    <g transform="translate(700, 170)">
        <!-- 2023 bar -->
        <text x="0" y="20" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>2023</tspan></text>
        <rect x="60" y="5" width="345" height="24" rx="4" fill="#5A6A7A"/>
        <text x="415" y="22" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>69%</tspan></text>

        <!-- 2024 bar -->
        <text x="0" y="60" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>2024</tspan></text>
        <rect x="60" y="45" width="324" height="24" rx="4" fill="#C62828"/>
        <text x="394" y="62" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E"><tspan>64.8%</tspan></text>

        <!-- Down arrow indicator -->
        <polygon points="430,55 440,45 450,55" fill="#C62828"/>
        <text x="460" y="58" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#C62828"><tspan>-4.2pp</tspan></text>
    </g>

    <!-- Key insight box -->
    <rect x="60" y="320" width="560" height="80" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#E0E5EA"/>
    <text x="80" y="350" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        <tspan>Key Insight</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="80" y="375" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>Globally, 84% of 65,437 respondents are currently working.</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="80" y="395" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>Freelancing and contracting remain significant at 16%+.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Regional context -->
    <rect x="660" y="320" width="560" height="80" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#E0E5EA"/>
    <text x="680" y="350" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        <tspan>Regional Patterns</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="680" y="375" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>U.K. & Ukraine lean toward contracting; Germany & India</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="680" y="395" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
        <tspan>have more full-time students.</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <line x1="60" y1="440" x2="1220" y2="440" stroke="#E0E5EA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="60" y="460" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#8A9AAA">
        <tspan>Source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2024 | n=65,437 respondents</tspan>
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8A9AAA" text-anchor="end"><tspan>02</tspan></text>
    <text x="640" y="695" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#8A9AAA" text-anchor="middle"><tspan>CONFIDENTIAL</tspan></text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- Slide 08: Key Takeaways -->
    <defs>
        <linearGradient id="topBarGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#005587"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0076A8"/>

    </defs>

        <tspan>Takeaways: What These Trends Mean for Hiring & Retention</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Five key takeaways -->
    <g transform="translate(60, 90)">
        <!-- Takeaway 1: Full-time employment softening -->
        <g transform="translate(0, 0)">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="560" height="100" rx="8" fill="#F5F7FA" stroke="#E0E5EA"/>
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="8" height="100" rx="4" fill="#C62828"/>

            <text x="25" y="30" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
                <tspan>1. Full-time employment softening</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="25" y="55" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
                <tspan>U.S. full-time dropped 4.2pp YoY (69% → 64.8%). Plan for</tspan>
            </text>
            <text x="25" y="75" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#5A6A7A">
                <tspan>a more contractor-heavy workforce. Freelancing remains at 16%+.</tspan>
            </text>
        </g>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

[Transition] Today we present findings from the 2024 Stack Overflow Developer Survey — the most comprehensive snapshot of the global developer workforce.

This deck covers compensation benchmarks, employment trends, and workforce dynamics to inform your hiring and retention strategies.

Key points: (1) 65,437 respondents from 180+ countries (2) Data-forward analysis targeting engineering and HR leaders (3) Actionable insights for compensation benchmarking

Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_employment

[Transition] Building on the survey scale, let's examine how developers are employed globally and the shifts happening in the U.S. market.

[Data] 84% of respondents are currently working — employed full-time, part-time, or freelancing.

Full-time employment dominates globally at 69%, with independent contracting at 16.4% and full-time students at 13.2%.

However, the U.S. shows a notable shift: full-time employment dropped from 69% in 2023 to 64.8% in 2024 — a 4.2 percentage point decline.

[Benchmark] This compares to stable full-time rates in Germany and India, where non-working respondents lean toward full-time student status.

[Pause] The strategic implication: your talent strategy should account for a more contractor-heavy workforce.

Key points: (1) Global full-time at 69%, U.S. declining to 64.8% (2) Freelancing at 16%+ remains significant (3) Regional variation in employment patterns

Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_work_environment

[Transition] The employment shift parallels changes in work environment — let's examine the three-year trend.

[Data] Hybrid work remains the most common arrangement at 42%, consistent with 2023.

Remote work accounts for 38%, down from 43% in 2022 — a 5 percentage point decline over two years.

In-person work has risen for the third consecutive year — from 15% in 2022 to 16% in 2023 to 20% in 2024.

[Benchmark] This 33% increase in in-person work (15% to 20%) signals a gradual return-to-office trend.

[Pause] For talent strategy: hybrid is the baseline expectation, but in-person is growing. Use flexibility as a differentiator.

Key points: (1) Remote declining 5pp from 2022 to 38% (2) Hybrid stable at 42% — still dominant (3) In-person rising 15% → 16% → 20% signals RTO trend

Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_salary_by_type

[Transition] Now let's examine compensation by developer type — the data reveals clear premium tiers.

[Data] Senior Executives top the chart at $127,388 median salary with ~17 years average experience.

Dev Advocates earn $124,203 (~16 years exp), and Managers $115,999 (~15 years exp) — all with 15+ years experience.

SREs and Cloud Infrastructure Engineers are the highest-paid purely technical roles: $99,099 and $96,666 respectively.

[Benchmark] SRE and Cloud Infra premium reflects critical importance in keeping digital services running 24/7.

At the lower end: Full-stack developers earn $63,333 (~10 years exp) and Front-end developers $48,787 (~8 years exp).

Regional variation: Mobile developers earn more in the U.S.; data engineers top charts in Germany and Ukraine.

Key points: (1) DevRel and leadership command $115K+ (2) SRE and Cloud Infra earn premium for technical roles (3) Experience correlates strongly with salary

Duration: 3 minutes

---

# 05_salary_vs_experience

[Transition] The correlation between experience and salary becomes clear when we plot all roles together.

[Data] The scatter plot reveals a cluster of senior roles in the upper-right — high experience, high salary.

Senior Executive ($127K, ~17 yrs), Dev Advocate ($124K, ~16 yrs), and Manager ($116K, ~15 yrs) form the premium tier.

Notably, SRE ($99K, ~10 yrs) and Cloud Infra ($97K, ~13 yrs) punch above their experience weight — high demand, limited supply.

The Student role is a clear outlier: $15,466 median with only ~2 years experience.

[Benchmark] The experience-to-salary ratio varies significantly by role — SRE and DevRel offer the best return on experience investment.

Key points: (1) Senior roles cluster at $100K+ and 14+ years experience (2) SRE and Cloud Infra offer premium pay relative to experience (3) Students as clear outlier at $15K

Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_salary_by_language

[Transition] Programming language choice correlates strongly with compensation — niche functional languages pay the most.

[Data] Erlang developers earn the highest median salary at $97K (~12 years exp), followed by Clojure at $95K (~11 yrs) and Elixir at $93K (~11 yrs).

Scala ($88K), Ruby ($89K), and Perl ($90K) round out the top tier.

[Benchmark] Compare to mainstream languages: Python at $67K, JavaScript at $64K, and PHP at $49K.

Dart ($44K) and Prolog ($43K) are the lowest earners among surveyed languages.

[Data] Important context: the overall salary range dropped roughly $10K compared to 2023 — averaging $60-75K now vs $70-85K last year.

[Pause] For hiring: niche functional language skills command a salary premium, but the talent pool is smaller.

Key points: (1) Erlang, Clojure, Elixir earn >$93K — niche languages pay more (2) Mainstream (JS, PHP) below $65K (3) Overall range dropped ~$10K vs 2023

Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_company_size

[Transition] Understanding where developers work and how they influence purchasing completes the picture.

[Data] 47% of respondents work for organizations with fewer than 100 employees.

The largest segment is 20-99 employee companies at 21.2%, followed by 100-499 at 18.5%.

Larger employers (1,000+ employees) account for about 27% combined.

[Data] 62% of developers influence technology purchases at their organizations.

By role: Senior executives 99%, engineering managers 87%, product managers 77%.

[Benchmark] This means developers — not just executives — are key purchase decision influencers.

60% of developers prefer a build-and-buy approach. Top evaluation methods: free trials (75%) and peer recommendations (73%).

[Scan Room] For vendor strategies: engage individual contributors directly, not just management.

Key points: (1) 47% work at sub-100 employee orgs (2) 62% influence tech purchasing (3) Free trials and peer recommendations drive evaluation

Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_takeaways

[Transition] To conclude: five actionable insights for your hiring and retention strategy.

1. Full-time employment softening — the U.S. dropped 4.2pp YoY. Plan for a more contractor-heavy workforce.

2. In-person mandates growing — hybrid remains dominant at 42%, but in-person rising. Use flexibility as a differentiator.

3. DevRel and SRE command premium — Dev Advocates ($124K), SRE ($99K), Cloud Infra ($97K). Budget accordingly.

4. Niche languages pay more — Erlang, Clojure, Elixir earn >$93K. Consider skill-based compensation.

5. Developers influence purchasing — 62% have buying say. Engage beyond just management.

[Pause] For questions or detailed appendix: survey.stackoverflow.co/2024

Key points: (1) Employment shifting toward contractors (2) DevRel/SRE critical and costly (3) Language choice correlates with pay (4) Developers are key purchase influencers

Duration: 2 minutes
